description: This file defines the Plus class, which implements a binary addition operation as part of a calculator project. It extends AbstractOperation and implements BinaryOperation, providing methods to perform addition and return the operation's symbol.

classes.name: Plus
classes.description: A class representing the binary addition operation in the calculator, extending AbstractOperation and implementing BinaryOperation.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Performs addition of two float arguments and returns the result.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the symbol representing the addition operation, which is '+'.
